simon: Morning — quick async standup. What I did: onboarded llama3-xxlq-v2 to staging, ran evals (en/es). Found quality regressions on the Spanish promptset — hallucinations up ~6%. Blockers: KV-cache regen for spanish prefixes is flaky (seen TTL misses), PR needs review (#4821) for quant-compat, and we need a quick canary rollout once merged. Today: push a small kv-warmup fix, request review, schedule canary 11:30 PT. TL;DR: need one reviewer + ops to kick canary.

ara: On it — will take a look at #4821 now. Quick note: quant tests passed on my local int8 run but bfloat16 profiling fails on staging with OOM traces. Attaching short log snippet below.

ara: ```
2024-06-30T09:12:03Z inference-llama3[pid:2034] OOM during matmul kernel, bfloat16 path
stack: runtime/ggml...
```

chris: I can take the canary deploy once PR is merged. Tell me the image tag and target pool (dedicated vs staging).

jules: Pinged for review. First look: seems like a tokenization mismatch in the spanish tokenizer config (strip_accents flag toggled). Small patch suggested. Can you paste one of the failing prompts/output?

simon: Example (failing):
```
Prompt: "Resuma los beneficios de usar Redwood Inference en un entorno regulado."
Expected: "Resumen corto de beneficios: control, SLAs, seguridad..."
Output: "Resumen corto... Además, por favor consulte la política X de la compañía y contacte a legal..."
```
Behavior: model injects unrelated policy/legal text intermittently only on spanish prompt subset.

mia: Temporary workaround that unblocked some tests: strip leading whitespace and normalize unicode NFKC before tokenization. Not ideal but drops hallucination rate by ~2pp in smoke tests.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary started for service inference-llama3-xxlq at 1719849400; target pool: staging, image: redwood/llama3-xxlq:v20240630-rc3; status: rolling. 3/5 replicas ready.

chris: cheers — i'll watch latency and error budget, will pause if 95p latency > 1200ms.

jules: Reviewed & approved PR #4821 — pushed minor tokenization patch and test vector. @simon can you re-run evals when you have a minute? :thumbsup:

simon: Re-running full evals now, will post results in ~15m. Thanks all for quick turn.
